description: A production starting point, the same rules as the pilot: a rule change waits as long as a revocation (24 h), as the contract requires, so the supervisory authority can veto either. Requiring the supervisory authority on every revocation (component 10.2's alternative) is "requiredRoles": ["C"] under revoke. Every role may veto; "vetoRoles" narrows that, so one compromised key of another role cannot stop every decision.
